messages.subject: how to update Numericinput
parts:
Currently, I have 5 numericInput boxes, where I set each numericInput in one conditional panel, and check if the above numericInputs >1, then don't show the conditional panels. However, if I alter the values on top, the bottom ones get hidden but still has a value. How can I update the bottom value to be set to zero? I have tried to use updateNumericinput but I get an error saying it needs to be in a reactive expression. 

UI:

 conditionalPanel(
                 condition = "input.Average == false",
               
                 numericInput("A", label = "null",
                                                min = 0, max = 1, value = 1, step =0.01)
               ),
               conditionalPanel(
                 condition = "input.A < 1",
                 
                       numericInput( "B", label = "Inull",
                                    min = 0, max = 1, value = 0, step = 0.01)
               ),
               conditionalPanel(
                 condition = "(input.A + input.B) < 1",
                 
                       numericInput( "C", label = "null",
                                    min = 0, max = 1, value = 0, step = 0.01)
                 
               )... etc

Say, if A = 0.5, B = 0.3, C = 0.2. Then I set B = 0.5, C gets hidden however it still retains that value. 

Thanks you !
